> What does Shadow think? Such techno-manipulation is EVIL. Not because

> exploit them (and they would) have no souls.
> Did anyone watch Schindler's List?
> Do you think humans have progressed very much since then?
> 
> "Technology has gotten the human race into a fix from which there is not
> likely to be any easy escape."
> "The technophiles are taking us all on an utterly reckless ride into
> theunknown."
> "Never forget that the human race with technology is like an alcoholic

> --The Unabomber Manifesto
